subject: Transition playbook & owner confirmations — cutover rehearsal + fallback owners
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greenfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Transition playbook & owner confirmations — cutover rehearsal + fallback owners

Hi Emily —

Following our last demo, we want to lock a 60-min cutover rehearsal with your engineers, procurement, and our SE/CS leads so owners and fallbacks are clear before the production switch. Proposed agenda (short):
- 10 min: success criteria & roles
- 30 min: dry-run of cutover steps (data routing, failover)
- 15 min: fallback & incident escalation paths
- 5 min: next steps + calendar owners

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed Mar 17, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Mar 18, 08:00–09:00 PT
- Fri Mar 19, 13:00–14:00 PT

Can you confirm which option works for your engineers? Please loop in procurement/security contacts if we should include them live; otherwise procurement can be present for the first 15 minutes for signoff. Attached is an updated transition playbook and the cutover checklist.

Attachments: [Transition_Playbook_v2.pdf (PDF), Cutover_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

High-level owners from our side:
- Cutover owner: Jonas Weber (me)
- SE lead: Aditya Rao
- CS / ramp & rollback owner: Marissa Cole
- Operational fallback: Sergio Alvarez (oncall)

If one of these times is a hard no, propose two alternatives and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@greenfin.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@greenfin.com>, Noah Kim <noah.kim@greenfin.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transition playbook & owner confirmations — cutover rehearsal + fallback owners

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — appreciate the agenda and the playbook. Our engineering team has a standing release window on Wed afternoon so Wed 10am PT conflicts for a few folks. Thu 08:00 PT is possible but tight for our APAC engineers (they join early).

Can we do Fri Mar 19 at 13:00 PT? That works for the majority of the SRE and App teams. I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@greenfin.com) for the initial signoff and Noah (sec lead) for the security checklist — Noah, can you confirm whether you need a separate pre-read or if the playbook is sufficient?

If anyone from Redwood thinks the Friday slot will block a mandatory attendee, flag it and propose a 2nd option (we can also do Fri 10:00 PT if that helps).

—Emily
